## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
One Important defect needs fixing: `status()` shortens the revision to 7 characters, while `history()` and `completed()` use 12. Its own docstring says it uses "the same identifier as history", so a running deployment shows an identifier that differs from its history and completion lines. This review read both changed files in full and traced `status()` and `attempt_label()` against the existing helpers and the added tests. No tests were run. The `attempt_label()` output is covered by exact-match assertions in `tests/test_display.py:21-22`.

## Changes
The pull request adds `status(revision, attempt)` and `attempt_label(attempt)` to `app/display.py`, which produce a `Running: <revision> (attempt N)` line. It also adds tests for both functions in `tests/test_display.py`.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/display.py:14 — correctness — Use the 12-character revision prefix in status() — For the test fixture `REVISION = "0123456789abcdef..."`, `status(REVISION, 2)` returns `Running: 0123456 (attempt 2)`, but `history(REVISION)` returns `History: 0123456789ab` and `completed(REVISION)` returns `Deployed: 0123456789ab`. `short_revision = revision[:7]` contradicts the docstring at `app/display.py:13`, "Show the deployment revision using the same identifier as history.", and `history()` uses `revision[:12]` at `app/display.py:5`. The added test at `tests/test_display.py:14-15` checks only `startswith("Running: ")` and `endswith("(attempt 2)")`, so it passes with either prefix length. — Operators who compare a running deployment's status line with its history or completion lines see different identifiers for the same deployment, and no test catches the mismatch. — Fix: Change line 14 to `revision[:12]`, or share one helper with `history()`/`completed()`. Add an exact assertion such as `status(REVISION, 2) == "Running: 0123456789ab (attempt 2)"`.
